<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/metadata_observed_keys"}
#docs
Values are returned only for a path with at most 20 distinct values that are all short scalars. Cached for about 5 minutes.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_type` | `string` | **yes** | The kind of record to sample. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `entity_type` | `string` | The kind of record that was sampled. One of `customer`, `subscription`. |
| `sample_size` | `integer` | How many records were sampled. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.path` | `string` | The key's path, with dots for nested keys. |
| `data.rows` | `integer` | Sampled records that hold a non-null value here |
| `data.type` | `string` | The JSON type most records hold One of `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `object`, `array`, `null`. |
| `data.distinct_values` | `integer` | Number of distinct values seen for the key. |
| `data.values` | `array of object` | Top values, or null when the path has many or long values |
| `data.item_values` | `array of object` | For an array path: top item values, under the same limits |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Missing or unsupported entity_type |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/metadata_observed_keys?entity_type=customer" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
